domainFacts: `Disable_Expired_Item` runs after `Create_Expired_Violation` on ["Succeeded", "Failed"] (lines 1269-1274). If `Create_Expired_Violation` **fails**, `Disable_Expired_Item` still executes and sets `fsi_enabled=false`, removing the item from the `fsi_enabled eq true` filter on subsequent cycles. The violation is silently lost with no record created and no retry possible. Conversely, if `Create_Expired_Violation` succeeds but `Disable_Expired_Item` fails, the item remains enabled and generates a duplicate violation every 15-minute cycle (no dedup covers expired-item violations). (suppress: WARN-8579-01)
